engine.title: Engine
engine.fallback: {{engine}} can't run right now, so the built-in model is used.
engine.englishOnly: Transcription is English only for now.

local.name: Built-in Whisper
local.desc: Runs on this computer and needs no internet. The default.

localLarge.name: Larger Whisper
localLarge.desc: More accurate and slower, still on this computer. A one-time {{size}} MB download.

apple.name: Apple on-device
apple.desc: The speech recogniser built into macOS 26.

groq.name: Groq
groq.desc: Fast cloud transcription with your own key. Audio is uploaded to Groq.

groq.title: Groq
groq.desc: Groq stays off unless you add your own key. With a key, recordings are uploaded to Groq to be transcribed; the key itself never leaves the app's main process.
groq.whereKey: Add the key in the main window: Settings → Voice → Free Flow → Groq API key.

devices.title: Devices
devices.helpWindows: Automatic records what your computer plays, so the call's audio is Them.
devices.helpMac: Automatic records the Mac's audio through screen and system audio recording: allow Munder Difflin in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording. Or pick a loopback device such as BlackHole.
devices.helpLinux: Automatic records from a PulseAudio or PipeWire monitor source ("Monitor of …"). Pick another input if it chooses the wrong one.
devices.helpDevice: This computer can't record its own audio directly. Pick a loopback device (such as BlackHole) for the other side, or only your microphone is recorded.
devices.screenAccessOff: Screen & System Audio Recording is not allowed yet, so the other side can't be recorded automatically.
devices.testing: Listening. Speak, and play some audio.
devices.testHelp: Check both meters before a meeting. Nothing is kept.

vocab.title: Vocabulary
vocab.intro: {{count}} built-in technical names (Anthropic, Claude, Kubernetes, ARR …) and your own words keep spellings right.
vocab.limit: Up to {{max}} words of your own.
vocab.empty: No words of your own yet.

notice.mic-device-missing: The chosen microphone isn't connected, so the default one is used.
notice.system-device-missing: The chosen device for the other side isn't connected; only your microphone is recorded.
notice.system-no-monitor: No system audio monitor source was found; only your microphone is recorded. Pick an input for the other side in transcription settings.
notice.system-unsupported: This computer can't record its own audio without a loopback device; only your microphone is recorded.
notice.system-permission: Recording the other side needs Screen & System Audio Recording permission; only your microphone is recorded.
notice.system-no-audio: The computer's audio wasn't available; only your microphone is recorded.
